title: Organization-wide telemetry layer
summary: Decision-ready dossier for a local-first telemetry layer across organization applications. It inventories current Agent Studio signals, defines a privacy-bounded event envelope and log-level mapping, compares file, push, and hybrid bus options, recommends durable per-app JSONL plus best-effort local push, maps clustered signals to bounded orchestrator actions, establishes Agent Studio as the CI/CD, telemetry, alarm, and orchestration hub, and proposes a Coding Agent Chat error-cluster pilot before broader rollout.
